segments.sn35.141:1.2: Yopi hetu yopi paccayo cakkhussa uppādāya, sopi dukkho.
segments.sn35.141:1.3: Dukkhasambhūtaṃ, bhikkhave, cakkhu kuto sukhaṃ bhavissati … pe … jivhā dukkhā.
segments.sn35.141:1.5: Yopi hetu, yopi paccayo jivhāya uppādāya, sopi dukkho.
segments.sn35.141:1.6: Dukkhasambhūtā, bhikkhave, jivhā kuto sukhā bhavissati … pe … mano dukkho.
segments.sn35.141:1.8: Yopi hetu yopi paccayo manassa uppādāya, sopi dukkho.
segments.sn35.141:1.9: Dukkhasambhūto, bhikkhave, mano kuto sukho bhavissati!
segments.sn35.141:1.10: Evaṃ passaṃ … pe …‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānātī”ti.
